strings.en:
Detective Delaqua,  

I must thank you for delving into the depths of the latest underground crime ring to operate out of Divinity's Reach. I'm sure the people of this fine city would thank you for your tireless efforts at making it a safer place to dwell. More importantly, Miss Iaera's family will be relieved to have their daughter's body returned to them and not rotting away in some crypt beneath the city. That poor girl's death should be mourned. I can only imagine what she endured in those final days.  

As always, thank you for trusting a faceless benefactor. I will write again, should any more intel arrive at my door.  

—E
